{{Quote|I've got no use for pride. Talk to other Tarasin sometime&mdash;we males, we have no real need for ego. At least, us old ones. Anyone raised in a society where the females are in charge&mdash;in word as well as in deed&mdash;never learns the same unhealthy pride and ego that leads males of other species so easily into war. This is not to say that we do not understand war, just that we do not define ourselves by it. It is something to be done, when it must be done.|native4all, in a post on the Cularin holonet node|<ref name="Jungle Warfare" />}}
The handle '''native4all''' served as the user ID on the [[Cularin holonet node]] of a [[Tarasin]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived on the [[planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Tarasin participated in the [[Tarasin Revolt]],<ref name="Jungle Warfare" /> a conflict that took place on Cularin<ref name="LFCG">''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]''</ref> from [[161 BBY]] to [[154 BBY]]<ref name="Dates">The ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'' states that the [[Tarasin Revolt]] took place between 129 and 122 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], an event that is dated to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. The war can therefore be dated to between [[161 BBY]] and [[154 BBY]].</ref> between Tarasin natives and off-worlders.<ref name="LFCG" /> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Tarasin posted on the Cularin holonet node about his experiences during the revolt.<ref name="Jungle Warfare" />
